plain: Lost your card? Turn it off with one tap, and turn it back on when you find it.
alt: Misplaced your card? One tap locks it, and you can unlock it once it turns up.
frame_flip: Don't let a lost card put your money at risk: lock it in one tap, and unlock it when you find it.
reordered: When you find your lost card, unlock it again; until then, lock it in one tap.
